title: Grateful Dead Live at Colden Auditorium - Queens College on 1970-10-10
lineage: Transfer: DAT > Sony PCM-M1 > Edirol HR09 > Wave > 24/88.2 - Transferred by John Jay Hance Lineage:  wav 24/88.2 > Adobe Audition 3 > iZotope RX7 Advanced > wav 16/48 > iZotope Ozone 5 Advanced > CD Wave > Flac 1648
source: Source: Sony F95's > Sony TC124s > Master Cassette (Ampex 361) > Cassette (Maxell XL2S) > DAT(48k) - Recorded by Ken and Judy Lee

ai_review.summary: Good audience‑sourced tape captures a laid‑back all‑electric set highlighted by a fierce “The Other One” and solid Hard to Handle and Sugar Magnolia performances.
ai_review.review: These reviews praise the upgraded recording for being far more listenable than earlier copies, delivering clear enough sound for a 1970 audience capture. Musically the show is described as a slow‑burn, all‑electric performance with standout moments like The Other One, Hard to Handle, Sugar Magnolia and an engaging Candyman coda.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently positive comments on both performance (not epic but enjoyable) and the improved sound quality lead to a solid combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Upgrade noted as highly listenable for 1970; previous copies were muddy, this version is clearer with acceptable fidelity for an audience cassette (Sony F‑95) recording.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A laid‑back, all‑electric set with a slow‑burn intensity; first set closes nicely with Cryptical > Drums > The Other One > Not Fade > GDTRFB jam, while the second set continues the relaxed vibe.
